开场动画里的那几个人都在：你坐 1 号，是好人；老格和汉娜就坐在你两边。镇上藏着: Everyone from the intro is here: you are in seat 1 and you are good; Old Greg and Hanna sit on either side of you. A Demon and its helper are hiding in town. Follow the tips: check your character, get a clue, chat privately by day, nominate, vote, and find the Demon.
每个人开局都会拿到一个秘密身份。点右边的身份牌把它翻开——别让旁边的人看见。: Everyone gets a secret character at the start. Click the card on the right to flip it, and don't let your neighbors see.
你是共情者：每天晚上会得知左右两边活着的邻座里，有几个是邪恶的。天黑以后说书人已: You are the Empath: each night you learn how many of your two living neighbors are evil. The Storyteller has already told you tonight's number. It's at the top of the "Role" tab, under "What you've learned".
日志里说：你两侧有 1 个邪恶。你左边是 2 号老格，右边是 7 号汉娜。（练习: Your info says 1 of your neighbors is evil. On your left is #2 Old Greg, on your right #7 Hanna. (This practice game gives you a freebie: Hanna is the Soldier, so she is good.) So the evil one must be… Keep it in mind and check it during the day.
天亮了，大家可以在小镇里自由走动。点地图上的任意地方走过去，或者用 WASD /: Day breaks and everyone can roam the town. Click anywhere on the map to walk there, or use WASD / the arrow keys.
走进一栋亮着灯的房子（比如广场旁边的面包房）。进了房子，你就会被拉进这间房子的私: Walk into a lit house (like the Bakery next to the square). Inside, you join that house's private voice chat and nobody outside can hear you.
在右上角点「锁门私聊」。锁上以后，别人走到门口只能敲门，你可以选择让他进来或者假: Click "Lock the door" at the top right. Once it's locked, anyone who comes to the door can only knock, and you choose to let them in or pretend nobody's home.
锁着门是出不去的。先点「开门」，再点「出去」回到街上。: You can't leave through a locked door. Click "Unlock" first, then "Leave" to get back on the street.
聊够了，大家要回广场提名。点「我想提前集合」——所有人都同意就会立刻集合（练习局: Done talking? Everyone heads back to the square for nominations. Click "I want to gather early": once everyone agrees, the town gathers right away (you're the only human in this practice game).
回到广场后可以提名。每人每天只能提名一次。点「提名」，再点座位圈上 2 号老格的: Back in the square you can nominate, once per day each. Click "Nominate", then click #2 Old Greg in the circle.
提名之后你有一段时间说理由——在语音里说就行。说完点「我说完了」，接着被提名的人: After nominating, you get some time to explain why. Just say it in voice chat. Click "I'm done" when you're finished, and the nominee defends themselves.
投票开始了：时钟指针从被提名者的下一位开始顺时针转，转到谁，谁的票就锁定。在指针: Voting has started. The clock hand moves clockwise from the player after the nominee, locking in each vote as it passes. Click "Raise hand" before it reaches you. If at least half the living players raise a hand (4 of 7), the nominee is executed at dusk.
票数出来了。票数够了，被提名者就会被送上处决台；黄昏时，台上的人会被处决。看看会: The votes are in. With enough votes the nominee goes on the block, and whoever is on the block at dusk is executed. Let's see what happens…
恶魔被处决，好人赢了。右边的「终局复盘」能看到每个人的真实身份、每晚谁得知了什么: The Demon was executed and Good wins. The "Game recap" on the right shows everyone's real character, what each player learned every night, and every Storyteller ruling. After a real game you can all go through it together. That's the end of practice. Good luck in Clocktower Town.
这次没投出恶魔: The Demon got away this time
没关系，真实对局里也常常这样。夜晚又来了，恶魔会杀一个人；明天白天你可以继续提名: No problem, it happens in real games too. Night falls again and the Demon kills someone; tomorrow you can nominate and vote again. To start over, click "Exit tutorial" and begin again.
